The receptionist is at the desk at right. Panel B, bottom left and tall: caption 'A quick vitals check first.' pages.observation: The order and tails are clear, and the nurse's action matches her line. Ravi's silent smile works as his response. In Panel C the label sits on the tablet screen and does not hide either of the doctor's hands, though its lower edge extends slightly past the screen area. The label still wraps with a dangling '·' ('RAVI ·' / 'READY'). Panel A ties Ravi to the slot clearly through his upward gaze. All text is readable.
